articleTitle: On the Issue of Weight Design of Aircraft on a Digital Platform in a Single Information Space of the Product Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: the weight and mass-inertial properties of the aircraft are some of the key characteristics that have a significant impact on its operational properties. The paper discusses the issues of automation of tasks of the weight design of the aircraft products in the single information space of the life cycle. The methodological foundations of the weight design are stated; the structure and functional implementation of a digital platform for the weight design of an aircraft are shown. The information basis of this system is the weight model of the aircraft, which is available in the information space to all participants at the stages of the life cycle.

articleTitle: Digital Twin of the Technological Process of the NPP Power Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents a flexible modeling system (FMS) of an NPP power unit. The principles of constructing an FMS based on selective programming and its structure are described, and the modeling and experimental data results are compared. This FMS can be considered a digital twin of an NPP power unit, which makes it possible to predict the course of the technological process and simulate the actions of operating personnel and failures of technological equipment.

articleTitle: Ecosystem Business Models: Methodological Problems of Identification and Some Methods for Describing Their Scaling Processes
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The methodological problems of identifying ecosystems as business models are revealed and systematized, their unique qualities, innovative potential are revealed, and their typology is studied. The systemic nature of ecosystem business models is established and the process of their scaling is described on the basis of the project approach.

articleTitle: Data Mining and Risk Potential Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article examines data mining issues and the construction of prediction instant models on their basis. The article discusses an approach to analyzing information for constructing a prediction instant model of the manufacturing process parameters at the NPP power unit and assessing the risk potential using the example of predicting the feedwater temperature after the high-pressure heater 5.

articleTitle: Some aspects of critical information infrastructure risk management
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes a descending functional framework for assessment and management risk of critical information infrastructures (CII), including defining the risk management scope, defining CII functions, analyzing the value chain of critical functions and interconnections, assessing the risk of critical functions, prioritizing and processing the risks of critical functions.

articleTitle: Configuration Management for Unmanned Aircraft Basic Systems at the Different Stages of Its Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes approaches to the use of configuration control of PAS using the principles and rules laid down in the control of the life cycle of manned aircraft, taking into account the necessary categorization of unmanned aircraft.

articleTitle: Selection of Personalized Parameters of the Object Model in a Closed Control System of the Blood Glucose Level
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of constructing the simplest closed system for controlling the glucose level in the blood of patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus is studied, taking into account the individual characteristics of the patients. Based on the study of the sensitivity of control quality criteria to changes in the parameters of the patient's model, “personalized” parameters are identified that require individual identification, which makes it possible to improve the quality of control in comparison with regulation without taking into account the individuality of the patient.

Author Keywords: taking into account the influence of the sensor

articleTitle: Optimal Synthesis Method for Signalized Intersection of Urban Highways with Route Branching
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Intersection control by joint selection of a phase-wise traffic separation scheme and optimization of traffic light control at the required traffic flow (TF) intensity on each passage directions, including branching routes, is considered taking into account the probabilistic nature of the TFs. The formulations and methods for solving optimization problems using the model of TF on the road lane are presented.

articleTitle: Complex of Models for Strategic Management of the Development of Large Transport Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The theoretical and methodological foundations, methods, technologies and components of the complex of models for strategic management of the development of large-scale transport infrastructure are characterized. The use of the complex of models is illustrated by examples of strategic management of the development of transport infrastructure of Siberia, the Far East, the Russian Arctic, and of JSC Russian Railways.

articleTitle: Enterprise Digital Twin Research
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The digital twin of the enterprise is a dynamic basic model of the enterprise which considers and describes the processes of product development, the dynamics of material (products, production funds) and financial flows (investments, assets, liabilities, equity), as well as the proper accounting of technological connections, centralization and management and economic goals of production. The statement of the optimization problem is given when the enterprise acts as an independent economic agent. Based on the one-step version, a game-theoretic model is formed in the presence of a management Center that has primary resources for production. A schematic diagram of the calculation of the best-guaranteed result of the Center and a record of the search algorithm in pseudocodes are given.

articleTitle: Some Aspects of Quality Assurance in the Development of Digital Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses an approach to the quality management system of digital systems, which unites all stages of the life cycle. Some aspects of quality assurance in digital systems development were considering this approach, and the main factors of unsatisfactory quality were noted. The core of the digital system is system and application software; therefore, special attention is paying to the consideration of software errors (their categories and consequences) and the principles of building reliable software used in the development of software for upper-level digital systems of NPP APCS.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Information consumption and dissemination: A study of online social network VKontakte
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In the context of the Coronavirus pandemic, it is crucial to analyze society's reaction to the information agenda related to the pandemic. This study examines news produced and broadcast by socially significant sources of information (in particular, accounts of news agencies, magazines, and newspapers) on the online social network VKontakte and Vkontakte users’ consumption of these sources’ news.

articleTitle: Problems of Using Compromise Indicators for Proactive Threat Detection in Robotic Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers the current problems of applying proactive algorithms for detecting threats in robotics complexes and structures the ways of solving them. A classification of indicators of compromise for the proactive search of previously unknown threats in robotic systems is proposed.

articleTitle: Risk Accounting in Calculations of Public Efficiency of Large-scale Infrastructure Projects
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article introduces the concept of a socially significant investment project, and examines special features of the “risk” concept in relation to such projects. A method is proposed for taking into account the risk of large-scale projects for the development of network transport infrastructure, based on analysis and assessment of each specific risk of a unique socially significant project. The foreign practice of evaluating megaprojects' efficiency is analyzed, from the point of taking into account uncertainty and risks, as well.

articleTitle: Models and Algorithms for Managing the Process of Eliminating the Flood Effects at Flood-Prone Objects and Areas
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A problem of managing the process of eliminating the flood effects is formulated for flood-prone objects and areas. A system dynamics model determined the flood effects characteristics has been developed to solve the problem. The algorithm of solving the problem of managing the process of eliminating the flood effects in which control functions are presented in the form of the action plans aimed to reduce the flood effects characteristics was developed.

articleTitle: On Solvability of Second-Order Semilinear Elliptic Equations on Spheres
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The work concerns the solvability of one class of semilinear elliptic second-order differential equations on spheres of finite dimension in the class of weak solutions. These equations are inhomogeneous analogs of the stationary Fischer– Kolmogorov–Petrovsky–Piskunov equation and are essential both from applied and pure mathematical points of view.

articleTitle: Feedback Control Algorithms for Some Classes of Nonlinear Systems with a Parameter at Finite Interval
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An efficient numerical algorithm is proposed to determine the feedback control for systems on a finite interval with a parameter at the control matrix that takes either small or large values and a small parameter that connects the subsystems in large dimension control problems. The algorithm is based on the construction of asymptotic expansions of the state-dependent differential Riccati equation in the SDRE approach by a small parameter or its inverse value. The resulting expansions are used as a basis for tuning of two-point Padé approximations of the gain matrices.

Author Keywords: control problems on a finite interval

articleTitle: Adaptation of Capacity Expansion Optimization Models Taking into Account Heterogeneous Requirements for Power Industry Decarbonization
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The possible ways to improve the flexibility of capacity expansion optimization models for planning the development of power systems in conditions of the increasing requirements of their decarbonization are considered. The approach to modelling of the impact of carbon tax and its effective use as an additional investment resource for supporting non-carbon power plants is shown as well.

articleTitle: Technological Infrastructure Management Models and Methods Based on Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper studies the large-scale infrastructure facility digital twin (DT), which represents both administrative and technological aspects of the facility, as a key component of the facility automated control system. The DT domain is identified through the ontological model. We propose DT-based methods to improve the efficiency and safety of the facility operation.

articleTitle: Toward the Foundations of Methodology for the Practical Use of Structural Identification Mathematical Methods in Conditions of Prior Structural Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The work contains new concepts in system structural identification developed by the author of this work. All the developed concepts reflect the significant properties of a specific type of structural identification, which has the following property. All specific structural identifications related to this type are part of creating a real automatic control system with the required properties under prior structural uncertainty conditions. The work includes a meaningful formulation of the risk problem arising from the practical use of the Mallows' method or its parametric generalization. The work contains the results of a preliminary theoretical study of the risk problem.

Author Keywords: the automatic control system with the required properties
the study of the risk problem

articleTitle: Features of the Intelligent Interface of the Aircraft Crew
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: For effective aircraft control in difficult situations, it is desirable to formulate recommendations for the crew based on the use of artificial intelligence technologies and mathematical modeling within the framework of an intelligent interface. The work is devoted to the peculiarities of such interfaces when solving some important tasks onboard the aircraft.

articleTitle: Threat Comparison for Large-Scale Systems Using Different Browsers
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The main threats in complex networks for large-scale information systems using web browsers or service browsers are analyzed. The necessary security features for these types of systems are compared. The advantages of systems developed with service-browser technology are shown.

articleTitle: Intellectualization of Models for Monitoring Objects as Part of Complexes of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: Integration of Analysis Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Mathematical information models have been developed to support managerial decision-making to ensure the necessary technical characteristics of monitoring objects in multifunctional complexes with unmanned aerial vehicles. The integration of methods for modelling stochastic dynamic objects and methods of expert assessments at the initial stage of their life cycle is proposed.

Author Keywords: the complex of unmanned aerial vehicles

articleTitle: Classification of Texts Using a Vocabulary of Synonyms
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this work we try to classify 5,063 blog texts written by 68 authors using XLM Roberta Large Xnli model (from Facebook AI) and a vocabulary of Russian synonyms.

articleTitle: Forecasting Time Series in the Banking Sector Using a Machine Learning Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article is devoted to the applications of machine learning methods for solving optimization problems in the banking sector. The literature analysis on the application of methods for forecasting time series in economics and finance is presented. A universal scenario for forecasting a large number of non-stationary time series in automatic mode has been developed. The use of the developed scenario for solving specific banking tasks to improve business efficiency, including optimizing demand for ATMs, forecasting the load on the call center and cash center, is considered. This article will be helpful for specialists dealing with the problem of forecasting economic time series and students and researchers due to a large number of links to systematic literature reviews on this topic.

articleTitle: Modeling of Carbon Payment Impacts on Electricity Prices and Possibility for Mitigation of Negative Effects on Consumers
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Carbon emission payment is considered as one of the widely used mechanisms to stimulate the shift towards low and non-carbon technologies in the power sector. As a special environmental tax, this payment can be accumulated on a competitive basis (via market price) or a regulatory basis. In the article, we use financial models of the power industry's segments to evaluate their required gross revenue as well as the average electricity price for end-users. We also observe possibilities for mitigation of negative price effect linked with support of non-carbon energy through carbon payment mechanism.

articleTitle: Identification of the Railway Track Technical State
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Road congestion, reduction of carbon dioxide emissions, increased speeds encourage industrial enterprises to use railways more actively. The efficiency of the railways is enhanced by infrastructure upgrades and improved maintenance. This is achieved by the introduction of modern data collection, storage and processing technologies.

articleTitle: Graph Interpretation of the Method of Orthogonal Projection for Regularization in Multiagent Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This report is devoted to the problem of regularization in agreement of characteristics and consensus in multiagent systems. Based on the theory of generalized matrix inverses and algebraic graph theory, it is proved that the method of orthogonal projection is a natural generalization of the consensus method for a disconnected communication digraph. The graph interpretation of the method of orthogonal projection is given.

articleTitle: Large-scale Organizational and Technical Systems Sustainable Development Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article's subject is socio-cyber-physical self-organization based on the Internet of things, mobile systems, cognitive technologies, and wireless switching of new generations 4G, 5G, and higher. The purpose of the research is to use the socio-cyber-physical self-organization strategy for methodological and instrumental support of network technologies for remote interdisciplinary controlling the functioning and development of large-scale organizational and technical systems. The study's relevance is due to the increased requirements for indicators of fault tolerance, survivability, information security, and warranty periods for the operation of digital organizational and technical systems.

articleTitle: Linguistic Model of Transportation Services Catalog
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An approach to forming a model of a digital intelligent catalog of transport services based on the theory of formal languages is proposed. The interaction of the system with the client is described by the rules of formal translation, in which the input language is the client's language, and the output language is the language of logistic schemes for the performance of services.

articleTitle: Effective Means of Regional Management: Optimal Use of Heterogeneous Resources
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of minimizing the cost of using a heterogeneous complex of resources in regional planning is considered. Volumes and directive intervals characterize the works. An algorithm for constructing an admissible distribution of resources of minimum cost has been developed, based on reducing the initial problem to a network flow problem of a particular kind. Applications of the considered models to the solution of problems of regional management are offered.

articleTitle: Equilibrium in Market Models
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the existence of equilibrium in several market models. In these models the supply and the demand functions are determined by the price elasticity coefficients of goods presented on the market. We obtained necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of equilibrium in the market model without import. Also we obtained sufficient conditions for the existence of equilibrium in the open market model as corollaries of theorems on coincidence points for mappings of metric spaces. Conditions on the uniqueness and nonuniqueness of equilibrium in open and closed market models in the form of conditions on model parameters are obtained.

articleTitle: Opportunities and Challenges of Initiative-Innovative Cluster Structures within Large-Scale Systems of the Medical Industry and Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article deals with the concept of initiative-innovative cluster development in the large-scale systems of the medical industry and healthcare. Risk management based on various criteria is also essential for ranking medical enterprises considering internal and external environmental conditions. We researched the possibility of medical industry enterprises and healthcare institutions participating effectively in innovative cluster structures. The authors proposed a model for identifying the compliance of the input indicators of the economic system with a specified output using the Kohonen neural network to estimate the initiative cluster effectiveness and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Approach to Building a Model Complex for Managing the Development of Hydrogen Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Based on causal analysis of the trends in the development of hydrogen energy, the concept of the structure of a digital complex, which combines various mathematical and simulation models, is proposed. Development is the process of changing the structure of a system to achieve goals. We assume that such a complex will help identify bottlenecks in forecasting development and outline the necessary efforts to accelerate it.

articleTitle: Neural-based Visual Odometry Trained in a Virtual Enviroment for a Mobile Robot Navigation
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Visual odometry is a well-known technical problem, which is crucial for navigation of autonomous mobile robots in buildings or hard-to-reach areas where no precise external navigation is available. We propose an architecture of a neural network capable of solving the stated problem. Training of the network is performed based on data collected within a virtual environment. Additionally we suggest an algorithm for filtration of gathered data based on sensor fusion methods. The inputs of the whole system are two sequential videoframes and the subset of inertial sensor readings. The output of the proposed system is a vector of motion parameters containing information on robot's linear and angular velocities. The conducted experiments confirm adequacy and show possible application of the proposed network architecture and filtering algorithm for searching people lost in a forest.

articleTitle: Design of Optimal Well Positions on Gas Fields
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We propose a combined optimization model for a coherent solution of the three following tasks: optimization of producer wells' positions on gas fields, optimization of well pads, and well-to-pad assignment optimization. The model is constructed in a form of bicriterial Boolean programming problem. We provide and discuss example cases and applications.

articleTitle: Impulse Disturbance Filtration at Digital Substations
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The work presents a one-part model of the transition process in the electricity system. Laplace transform applies mathematical models of signals on digital substations. The author offers a spectral representation of analysis methods on the Laplace transform. The synchronized phasor measurement methods are for determining and filtering the carrier frequency. The results of the frequency analysis are input data for the diagnostics of digital substation devices. We present the developed software of a frequency diagnostic process using FIR-filter and choose an adequate model structure of simulated electrotechnical objects of synchronized phasor measurements. Finally, the article discusses the prospects of applying the proposed approach to solve the problems determining the primary frequency in a digital substation.

articleTitle: New Silk Road: Modeling the Interaction of the Logistic Process Participants on the Railway Transport
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The main challenges and promising projects for the development of the logistics system of the New Silk Road are considered, including the structure of the Russian and world market of transport and logistics services, existing and prospective networks of transport and logistics centres at the polygon of the International Transport Range across the territory of the CIS countries. A technological model of the functioning of railway terminals in Russia is presented. The principles of modelling the interaction of international transport corridor counterparties are proposed, including the formalized model of the carrier's functioning, the model of the functioning of the logistics centre, as well as the model of their joint functioning.

articleTitle: MNM-Modelling and Creating Designs of Discrete Microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper is devoted to developing discrete microfluidics using multidimensional network models (MNM). The method provides the possibility of generating a set of possible variants of the invention in the form of MNMs and selecting the best design variant using analyzing both the structure and the features of the MNMs. For example, the paper reports results of designing the microfluidic three-stage generator, including the design MNM and the experimental model.

articleTitle: Is inoculation effective against fake news? a mathematical model
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper introduces a dynamical model of the spread of fake news countered by both inoculation and debunking. The model assumes that a fake news message is published once, then spreads as a rumor by the spreaders, that is, by deceived individuals. Inoculation is conducted for part of the population in advance of the publication. Debunking begins after the publication and is carried out continuously by mass media and by skeptics, i.e., individuals who have internalized the debunking message. Building on the empirical literature, I account for the fact that fake news messages are normally more contagious via interpersonal communication than debunking messages. Numerical experiments with the model show that the effects of inoculation are limited. The proposed explanation for the limitations is that inoculation is not contagious while debunking by mass media provides less-than-linear growth of sceptics (given a constant intensity of debunking broadcasting). At the same time, the spread of a message through interpersonal communication yields nearly exponential growth of spreaders at early stages of the process. Therefore, if a fake news message is contagious enough, its spreaders quickly outnumber the sceptics. In such cases, inoculation and debunking cannot effectively counter fake news in the short run, although debunking enables sceptics to prevail in the long run.

articleTitle: Economic analysis of one type of criminal activity
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper provides a formal analysis of the regularities of functioning and development of economic crimes. It was expedient to find out the conditions in which theft would not be worthwhile, i.e., supplement legal research with the economic analysis. The analysis results will help to find ways of rational crime counteraction and minimize the damage from it.

Author Keywords: the possibility of minimizing damage from criminal activity

articleTitle: Choosing an Agricultural Insurance Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the risks that farmers who produce agricultural crop products are exposed to. These risks are associated with uncertainty in the yield of the crops grown and the price of the products produced. Mathematical models of the leading agricultural insurance programs are presented, and the characteristics of these programs are given. Based on the results suggested, recommendations for choosing the necessary program are formulated.

articleTitle: A Software Complex of Preparation for Solving a Multilinear Programming Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Models based on multilinear functions are considered. Previously, a form was proposed for representing the original multilinear programming problem in the form of two tables: a table of monomials, a table of multilinear constraints, and a criterion. In this paper, two tables are combined into one which includes tables of monomials and multilinear functions. It is created in a screen editor and saved in a sequential file. The user can read the description of the multilinear programming problem in the editor, adjust its parameters, to a certain extent, and the structure of the model, and start optimization. Formulas for evaluating multilinear constraints with control for weakness and incompatibility are proposed. The technology is illustrated in various models. For a specific bilinear model, it is substantiated that the obtained solution of the multilinear programming problem gives the absolute maximum of the criterion.

articleTitle: Seismic Anomalies in the Geothermal District Revealed by the Relaxation Algorithm of Selected Coordinate Descent
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The relaxation algorithm of the selected coordinate descent has been developing to control the underground seismic structure beneath the industrial subjects. The distinctive feature of the algorithm is in the interdisciplinary approach to choose nonzero components of the starting point. Application of the algorithm to seismic data recorded in complex geological conditions has shown an improvement in statistics characterizing the accuracy of the inversion solution. Based on seismic images, we have studied the cause of the 1976 Kopasker earthquake in northeastern Iceland. We concluded that the drilling of production geothermal wells was hardly the main factor provoking this event in the region. For the planning of fuel energy subjects, the following result might be using. The location of the earthquake epicenter is at the boundary between two contrasts: high and low seismic velocity areas.

articleTitle: Management of Risks for Complex System Based on a Generalized Arbitration Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper is concerned with an approach to constructing mechanisms for managing the security of a complex system in conditions where the local risk functions of independent elements of the system are random. It proposed to use linear or quadratic functionals of a particular type as a framework for ordering local risks.

articleTitle: Indicative Time Planning in Strategic Goal Programs for the Development of Complex Large-Scale Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers the model of time planning in strategic goal programs of innovative development of complex, large-scale systems. In practice, a creative project has conjunctive logic, and we describe it in the space of time-cost-reliability variables. The time indicator of the goal program (large-scale project) is found from the solution of the optimization problem, for which we use an effective method. The Weibull distribution gives the activity reliability index. In this case, we obtain a lower bound on the reliability indicator of the project as a whole. The table provides the results of numerical calculations for the test example.

articleTitle: A Study on the Control of the Dynamics of Multidimensional Opinions in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This study considers a model of the dynamics of opinions in social networks. The model implements two interrelated information processes: the spread of activity and the formation of opinions. For this model, the problem of choosing an impact strategy by the control subject (principal) is formulated and solved, which ultimately allows for obtaining maximum support in the social network. The problem of information confrontation is then considered and solved.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Control Design for Path Following Stabilization of a Wheeled Robot under the Action of an External Uncontrollable Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A decomposition procedure for the synthesis of linear and nonlinear feedbacks that stabilizes linear and angular deviations from a given path invariant to external disturbances is developed to solve the problem of track stabilization of a mobile robot on the plane, taking into account the restrictions on state variables and control. Simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Application of the Covering Method for Trajectories Design for Car-like Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses an algorithm for constructing simple motion maneuvers for a system describing the movement of a car-like robot by the covering method. The flatness of the system is proved, and the construction of the corresponding covering is given. Computational experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Overview of the Software Complex for High-Frequency Exchange Trading on the Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A computational complex for processing large volumes of data generated on exchanges in high-frequency mode is described. Procedures for conducting exchange trades, strategies for algorithmic trading, theoretical setting of portfolio optimization, and practical techniques for carrying out real operations are limit orders presented. Fundamental importance is attached to the search and configuration of controls on the observation rows, and the central place in the project is the development of a software simulation complex. The developed robot successfully performed at the demonstration events of the exchange.

articleTitle: Optimization of Shale Oil Development Based on a Two-zone Economic Model
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A two-zone model of shale oil production is built. The task is to optimize the ratio of the horizontal wellbore length to the reserves of the zone directly affected by hydraulic fracturing (the intensive production zone). The oil crossflow from the reservoir's far zone to the one adjacent to the well is taken into account. The NPV economic optimization criterion is used. A numerical example is provided.

articleTitle: Optimal Control in Agent-Principle Problems for the Quasi-Public Sector
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses human resource management problems in the quasi-public sector (education, healthcare, military industry, etc.). It is shown that the behavior of these organizations can be described as unproductive workers' payment maximization. The formalization of this task based on the model of the external and internal labor market is proposed.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Detecting Changes in the Properties of Non-Stationary Processes in the Monitoring Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this report, we have considered the problem of detecting and identifying the types of changes in non-stationary time series that lead to the need to rebuild the models describing the process. We compare two approaches to the construction of algorithms for detecting changes in the monitoring mode: fluctuation tests for detecting structural changes and sequential detection algorithms. The sequential algorithms have optimal properties in the sense of the criterion for the fastest detection.

articleTitle: Identification of Integrated Rating Mechanisms, Taking into Account the Preferences of a Group of Agents
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of integrated rating mechanisms identification taking into account the preferences of a group of agents, is discussed. Each agent can express messages about the integrated rating mechanisms, exactly about the structure of the criteria tree and the elements of convolution matrices for a fixed set of criteria. It is required to identify the true opinions of agents about the significance of private criteria, which must be considered in the integrated rating mechanism to multi-criteria decision making.

articleTitle: Management and Monitoring of Rare Earths Circulation in the Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The features of rare-earth metals, which must be considered in their circulation in the economy, planning and making managerial decisions, are considered. Modern industries noted an imbalance between the raw material base and the demand for rare earth metals. When analyzing the imbalance, it is possible to use linear programming methods.

articleTitle: Control of Electromechanical Plant under Uncertainty and State Variables Constraints
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, the decomposition procedure of synthesis of nonlinear local feedbacks is developed for an electromechanical plant, operating in conditions of parametric and external disturbances. The developed procedure provides tracking by the output variable of the given signal with some accuracy in presence of constraints on state variables and control action. Results of numerical simulation are presented.

articleTitle: Regional Migration in Russia: Dynamics, Features, Expectations
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper examines the new features and dynamics of internal migration processes in the Russian Federation at the present time (2015–2020). The results of a comparative statistical study on the regions of Russia are presented. In the context of global integration, citizens of all countries, including Russia, have the opportunity to study and analyze in more detail issues related to the financial, economic, social, labor and other policies of various regions and states, and other aspects of life. Therefore, there was a desire, and sometimes a need to change the place of their further residence (both within the country and abroad). At present, internal migration should be considered as a global social phenomenon, a powerful source of demographic improvement. Various aspects of migration processes that are currently observed are studied by many authors. This is understandable: in the life of any state, population migration plays an important role, affecting all spheres of life of the peoples of the countries. Migration processes for Russia are one of the main factors that determine the socio-economic development of modern Russian society, its demographic well-being. Internal migration of the population affects the socio-economic relations in the country, solves the issues of labor and employment of the population, as it allows millions of Russians to find new jobs. Issues of population migration should be regularly monitored and analyzed in order to correctly determine the reserves and plan the growth of the country's population on this basis, and to rationally and responsibly conduct the state's migration policy. The paper examines the new features and dynamics of internal migration processes in the Russian Federation at the present time (2015–2020). The results of a comparative statistical study on the regions of Russia are presented.

articleTitle: Application of factor analysis and neural networks for prediction in taxi service
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this work, a study of multidimensional data on the operation of a taxi ordering service was carried out in order to predict the cost of an application. It is shown that it is possible to single out the main components, on the basis of which a sufficiently accurate prediction with respect to the initial data set is possible.

articleTitle: Features of the Innovation Modeling of the Russian Gas Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to the features of optimization modelling of the innovative development of the gas industry in Russia for the long term. Considered (updated) innovative trends in the entire production chain - geological exploration, production, processing, storage, liquefaction and transportation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Synergistic Effects of Failures in Complex Network Structures
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The synergetic consequences of multiple failures of objects of complex network structures in the inverse vulnerability problem are considered. The consequences of such failures depend on the composition of the failed objects, their position in the structure. A method for searching for “dangerous” objects based on the frequency analysis of cross sections with maximum synergistic effects is proposed.

articleTitle: Placing replicas of data arrays in dynamic distributed systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents a method for adaptive reallocation of data arrays and their replicas among the nodes of a distributed system, the parameters of which are dynamically changing. A heuristic algorithm for replicas reallocation depending on the current parameters of a distributed system is presented.

Author Keywords: redistribution of data arrays and their replicas

articleTitle: Synchronization of Reserved Information in Large-Scale Control Systems for APCS of NPP
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The task of synchronizing reserved information in the form of data coming to the Top-level subsystem (TLS) from Low-level subsystems (LLS) of the Automated Process control system (APCS) of a Nuclear power plant (NPP) is considering. The method of solving this problem and the algorithm implemented in APCS NPP software are proposing.

articleTitle: Long-Term Development of Regions: the Historical Basis and Activity of the Regional Authorities
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: According to the “passive experiment” with the use of a modified method of the cutting Poincare surface, a comparative study was made of the long-term development of the regions of Germany. Such a comparative study of the dynamics of development made it possible to identify for Germany the presence of three formed groups of regions. It was revealed the existence of threshold values of the specific Gross Domestic Product and specific disposable income that prevent the transition of the region to successful development

articleTitle: Application of the Modified Method of S-Approximations within the Framework of the Structural-Parametric Approach for the Construction of Regional Analytical Models of the Magnetic Field of Mars
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We have constructed an analytical model of the magnetic field over a region of the Martian surface using satellite raw data and S-approximations within the modified structural-parametric approach. The method mentioned above implies considering the environment features as a function included in an integral. We approximated the anomalous field by the sum of simple and double layers distributed over two concentric spheres lying at different depths below the reference surface. We have presented an analytic downward continuation of the magnetic field of Mars at various distances, including the planet's surface.

articleTitle: Neural Network-Based Methods for Forecasting Financial Time Series
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses methods for predicting time series based on neural networks. Distinctive features of neural networks in forecasting are described. A case study with constructing a neural network-based forecast is considered.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Invariant Systems under Uncoordinated Disturbances Based on the Theory of Sliding Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper proposes a new philosophy for the synthesis of sliding modes using the method of expanding the state space and the block approach in control. An important feature of the developed algorithms for the synthesis of invariant systems, in contrast to systems with deep feedbacks, is the modulus constraint of controls and state vector coordinates.

Author Keywords: constraints on phase variables and control

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Managing the Agricultural Holdings in Building a Digital Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This work presents the original proprietary mathematical model for interregional agricultural holding management relying on the harmonized digital platform of the Russian agrarian sector that allows conceiving the general formalized approach to the strategic direction of various integrated establishments within the sector. The approach provides a theoretical substantiation for harmonized approaches to the long-term digital transformation of major agricultural associations followed by medium and small businesses.

articleTitle: Comparison of Two Algorithms for Solving the Problem Aircraft Arrival Sequencing and Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper proposes a genetic algorithm with an original crossover operator and a hybrid algorithm that allows increasing the efficiency of the genetic algorithm at the final stage of solving the problem. We also compare the efficiency of the proposed hybrid algorithm and the well-known genetic algorithm with the representation of chromosomes in the form of binary matrices.

articleTitle: Modelling of the Applied Research Diversification in the High-Tech Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The optimal research and development program should be formed taking into account the risks and uncertainties inherent in scientific research, as well as the limitations on available resources. The paper offers tools based on the consideration of market and integration risks to ensure the assessment the expediency of diversifying the areas of possible application of the developed technological complexes. The paper considers the economic validation problem of the advantages of this approach in comparison with the option of making a decision to create particular product samples at the early stages of research and development.

articleTitle: Development of a Large-Scale Holding for Servicing World-Class Oil and Gas Projects
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report presents the methodology and results of the assessment of the development of the Russian large-scale holding. The analysis of indicators characterizing the multidimensional production, economic, and personnel specifics of the work of a unique Russian company - PJSC Sovcomflot, specializing in the transportation of products, and services for the domestic oil and gas complex.

articleTitle: Features of Choosing the Optimal Operating Modes of an Autonomous Power Center Based on Gas Piston Units
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Methodological approaches to the selection of optimal modes of an energy center based on gas piston units are considered, taking into account the factors of efficiency and reliability, if there is a possibility of backup and emergency power consumption from a centralized power supply system. It is shown that in the presence of an operating gas boiler in the power center, only the electrical load is subject to optimal distribution. The criteria of cost-effectiveness and reliability, taking into account technical and parametric constraints, as well as a general approach and algorithm for solving the two-criteria problem using the method of successive concessions are given.

articleTitle: Applying the Methods of Regression Analysis and Fuzzy Logic for Assessing the Information Security Risk of Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The proposed method allows us to determine the predicted value of the complex systems information security risk and its confidence interval using regression analysis and fuzzy logic in terms of the risk dependence on various factors: the value of resources, the level of threats, potential damage, the level of costs for creating and operating the system, the information resources control level.

articleTitle: DoS Attack Prevention Using the Static Window Flow Control in Sequent Connected Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article presents the model of the lossless network system with an input flow control regulator. The regulator uses a static window flow control algorithm to cut out of band data. The system consists of sequent connected devices, and the feedback to the regulator is provided from each device in the chain. This provides adaptive control algorithm implementation taking into account the buffer overflow in separate parts of the system. Limiting the input flow is a defense measure against denial of service (DoS) attacks. This algorithm is especially well for brute force kind of DoS attack. They don't use information about the internal structure of the attacked system. The model uses the Network Calculus approach for simulation of the regulator and computing the main characteristics of the system.

articleTitle: Tools and Methods for Functional Analysis of Complex Technical Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses the methods and tools of functional analysis performed in the stages of the life cycle of engineering systems in the general approach of model-based systems engineering. Such questions are relevant because they help to improve the efficiency of developing complex systems in terms of project risks. The authors, using a specific example, consider the possibility of implementing a functional analysis of a system using the Arcadia method in Polarsys Capella – model-based systems engineering supporting tool.

articleTitle: Safety and Quality of Air Criteria in Objects with Artificial Human Environments
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the criteria for the safety and quality of air in artificial human habitats, the factors of the influence of atmospheric air on the human environment, the main factors of influence of atmospheric air on the human environment. Risk factors of air security violation from internal sources of air pollution discussed.

articleTitle: Prediction and Stabilization of Elastic Oscillations of a Large Space Construction
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A approach to stabilizing the angular position of a large space structure is proposed, which is based on the prediction of the process of increasing the elastic oscillations of the structure. Of the many multi-frequency oscillations of the design, the dominant oscillating component is distinguished, information about which is used to predict. An algorithm for analyzing the dominant component is given. The task of setting the parameters of the basic algorithm for controlling the large space construction is solved. This setting allows you to stabilize the dominant component without the additional cost of control energy and ensure the required stabilization.

articleTitle: The Efficiency and Quality of Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of evaluating the efficiency and quality of information systems (IS). The differences between the concepts of “quality” and “efficiency” are given. The most well-known methods of IS efficiency evaluation are considered, and general approaches of IS efficiency indicators selection are formulated. The authors have developed proposals for lists of performance indicators and their calculation methods for various types of IS, taking into account systems features and conditions of their operation. There are presented the most IS quality models. It is noted that most of them relate to software quality assessment, while the regulatory base for assessing of IS quality is not sufficiently developed in general. The Authors make proposals for regulatory base improvement in the field of IS quality assessment.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Algorithms for Forecasting Technical Condition of Electromechanical Actuator
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper concerns the problem of searching for informative features to forecast the technical condition of an electromechanical actuator using the time series analysis technique. Algorithms have been suggested based on the optimization models enabling to find ranges of stationary signal spectrum integration providing maximal quality indicators of the trend.

articleTitle: On Assignments Verification During the ICS Databases Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Today, Industrial Control System (ICS) databases are incredibly complicated with quite prolonged iterative lifecycle where every new iteration is driven by a new version of the database assignment. For the correct databases development, the assignments should be consistent and correspond to special requirements, but this is not always the case. Therefore, the checking, or verification, of the assignments is becoming especially important. However, the appropriate problem of databases assignments verification is not widely discussed, and available verification methods are not suitable enough for solving the problem. The article clarifies the place of the assignments verification in the ICS databases lifecycle and presents a novel algorithm for the assignments verification. The particular implementation of the algorithm is also considered. As an example, the results of the verification of the assignments for the NPP ICS databases are presented.

articleTitle: The Use of Relaxation of Complementary Slackness Conditions for Jointing in General Equilibrium Models
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers a fairly simple dynamic model of general economic equilibrium, which demonstrates possibility of mitigating conditions of complementary slackness. Model describes interaction of Consumer, Producer and Bank, whose behavior is described by an optimization problem with a set of constraints.

articleTitle: Profit Maximization in a Gas Field Model
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider a dynamic continuous gas production at a deposit. We set and solve the optimization control problem for maximum profit, taking into account the discount factor. The problem posed relates to some optimal control problems with a mixed constraint with a fixed time and an unbounded right endpoint. We use the principle of Pontryagin maximum in the Arrow form.

Author Keywords: dynamic model of a gas deposit development
Pontryagin maximum principle in Arrow form
the uniqueness of the solution to a problem

articleTitle: Stochastic Principles of Optimality in Games with Nature and Their Application in Investment Management
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The principle of optimality in decision-making for games with nature, based on assessments of efficiency and risk, is proposed. In contrast to the traditional approach to the definition of a mixed strategy in game theory, this work considers the possibility of a correlation dependence of random values of payoffs for the original alternatives.

articleTitle: Distributed Monitoring System of Discharges of Enterprises-users of Natural Resources into the River Basin to Minimize Environmental Damage
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider a method for calculating buffer tanks for the temporary storage of wastewater containing pollutants of water user enterprises and algorithms for minimizing river pollution in accidents accompanied by an uncontrolled spill of contaminants. We propose a distributed control system structure for controlling discharges of enterprises-water users into a river basin.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Games with Limited Information about the Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A system of models for control a two-level hierarchical system under uncertainty is considered. It is assumed that subjects are not equally informed about the external environment. The article examines the question of the expediency of voluntary exchanges of unverified information and the closely related question of the expediency of decentralizing system management.

articleTitle: Stress Testing of Backbone Enterprises in Russia: a Case of Retail Trade
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We have developed a stress testing approach to determine the boundary values of indicators of the economic state of backbone non-financial enterprises when managing them according to the criterion of the cash balance. One of the principal indicators affected by the pandemic is considered – the change in the company's revenue. The formulation and method of determining the permissible change in revenue at which the enterprise will maintain normal functioning are proposed. As a condition for normal functioning, the non-negativity of the company's cash balance projected for the next year is assumed. From this condition, the permissible change in revenue is determined based on the obtained analytical expression and data from open sources, making it possible to reduce the complexity of determining the boundary values of the indicator. We analyzed the actual data for 2020 and compared it with the calculated results. We propose to use the concept of stress testing to select government-supported enterprises in a pandemic.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Informative Features Extraction in the Problem of Data Mining on Item Related State Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The algorithms for informative features extraction in the task of data mining on item related state evaluation have been considered in the report by way of example of evaluating and forecasting the technical status (early diagnosis task) of unmanned aerial vehicle electric motor where the reporting set of controlled variable values is applicable to a certain class or hazard level.

articleTitle: Analytical methods for minimizing the cost of repair work on pipeline networks in the formation of a digital double of infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Describing the methods of minimizing the cost of repair work in the areas of engineering networks for the practical assessment. This methods are the part of the information support system for the decision to extend the service life of the site on the example of the heat supply network.

Author Keywords: planning repairs of the engineering networks
determination of a complex indicator of the state of the site
assessing the parameters of the Weibull distribution

articleTitle: Applied Method for Parametric Identification of Electrotechnical Objects in Digital Substations
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Authors of this article review and analyze the main trends in the modern distribution networks development for electricity supply. These distribution networks can function effectively only with extensive and adequate use of parametric and non-parametric identification. We propose the general approach to parametric identification in power distribution networks. The authors of this article developed the applied method for the parametric identification of voltage converters in digital substations based on this approach. We select an adequate model structure of simulated electrotechnical objects. Parametric identification results are input data that organize the diagnostic process of digital signal converters.

articleTitle: The Express Valuation Model: Case of FAAMG Companies
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In the current paper, the authors present a model that is used for evaluation of the largest mature companies. The model is based on the discounted cash flow valuation method and uses data from 10-Ks. The authors exemplify the use of the model, provide a detailed description of the data fed to it, and analyze resulting estimates, which demonstrate an acceptable accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Statistical Expert Method for Monitoring an Enterprise's Financial Activities
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Integrated assessment hybrid method provides the functions of calculating and analyzing estimates of the financial and economic risk of instability and associated characteristics (life cycle dynamics, operational instability, growth or decline trends) of complex dynamic objects such as production plants, organizational and technical systems. In assessing the financial risks of business instability, various sources of information are taken into account: objective statistical data and subjective expert data on the mutual influence of a large number of factors of economic activity.

Author Keywords: the financial and economic risk of instability

articleTitle: Multi-Criterion Optimisation in a Problem of Preliminary Calculation of Maneuverable Aircraft Characteristics in the Presence of the Parameters with Epistemic Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A specific problem of preliminary calculation of supersonic manoeuvrable aircraft parameters has been considered under conditions of epistemic uncertainty. An itemized optimization algorithm has been implemented that takes into account expert appraisals of uncertain parameters and allows for obtaining the values of technical characteristics of an aircraft being developed with various levels of the degree of confidence in their implementation.

articleTitle: Chain of Digital Data Blocks Linked by a Numeric Linear Block Correction Code, as an Alternative to the Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Offers an alternative method to blockchain technology, providing digital data integrity and chronological order permanence of its elements. Method is based on coding the digital information data by a numeric linear block correction (error control, error-correcting) code (NLB-code) over the loop of terminating decimals.

Author Keywords: numeric linear block correction (error control) code (NLB-code)

articleTitle: Autonomous Navigation for Control of Unmanned Vehicles Based on Odometers and Radar Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper describes a new principle of building autonomous positioning systems for wheeled unmanned platforms when working in industrial premises without the use of inertial sensors, global satellite and local navigation systems. An algorithm for calculating the vector of movement of a transport platform on a plane using odometric and microwave radar sensors is presented. The procedure for controlling movement along a given route between waypoints using circular inserts based on the received data is described.

articleTitle: Research of the Stock Exchange Features Concerning Their Influence on Stock Quotes of Companies from the Various Sectors
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: It was analyzed the influence of stock exchanges on stock quotes of the automotive, energy and telecommunication companies. It was obtained comparative assessment of the profitability, risk and stability indicator of shares placed on different stock exchanges.

articleTitle: Acoustic Monitoring of the Psycho-Emotional and Physical State of Operational Personnel in the Management of High-Risk Objects Based on Self-Learning Neuromorphic Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A behavioral model of the operator is proposed, characterized by memory and several variables of the internal psycho-emotional and physical state, which allows for the effective projection of its structure and functioning algorithm on the hardware processing environment in the form of memristive structures with built-in memory and numerous variables of its state.

articleTitle: Decomposition of Multiple Time-Scale Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The decomposition problem for the singularly perturbed system with several time scales is considered in the paper. It is shown that the system under consideration can be reduced to several subsystems of the lower order.

articleTitle: Complexity Theory and a General Mathematical Approach to the Formal Description of the Tasks of Managing Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of forming a common base for mathematical modeling of control problems for complex systems based on the use of the principles of complexity theory and methodology based on the application of a situational approach to the development of managerial decisions and synthetic qualimetry in evaluation the situation of control in the schemes “situation-action” and situation-strategy-action “is considered. The features of the formal description of the control situation in control problems, as well as the problems that arise in the mathematical modeling of decision-making processes in the control problems of objects of great complexity are analyzed.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Supply Net Control for Transport Branch of Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problems of alternative and renewable energy are important due to many reasons. Hydrogen has better efficiency and minimal pollutions vs fossil fuels and even electro vehicles, and it can even save energy from other sources. However, its development should be profitable both in general and for all the participants of production, distribution, and consumption that require efficient control. The article considers some aspects of a vast enough hydrogen transportation system. Of particular interest is the development of the hydrogen supply network.

articleTitle: Analysis of the heterogeneity of Russian regions in terms of GRP and population income
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The regional heterogeneity of the Russian economy is analyzed by comparing the self-sustainability of the economic development of all its regions. In the XXI century the differentiation of Russian regions increased in terms of economic self-sustainability. In addition, the growth of this regional differentiation was ahead of the dynamics of the development of the country's economy.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Russian Agricultural Research Organizations' Digital Footprint
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This work analyzes domestic agricultural research organizations' ratings shaped by applying methodologies of generating such ratings with consideration to active, passive, and semiactive digital footprints in the internet space. A mathematical description of the methodologies is provided. The benchmarking analysis of the resulting ratings is presented.

articleTitle: SDDRE Based Approximate Solution in Trajectory Tracking Control Problem for a Model of Two-Wheeled Differentially Driven Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the problem of implementing a reference trajectory for a nonlinear model of a two-wheeled robotic system. Each of the two wheels has independent control. An approximate solution to the trajectory tracking control problem is obtained based on a modification of the well-known heuristic approach based on the state-dependent differential Riccati equation (SDDRE) technique. The advantage of the obtained solution is its computational efficiency. Numerical experiments showed that the quality of the obtained control is slightly inferior to the quality of the control obtained using the regular SDDRE.

articleTitle: Economic and Mathematical Model of a Group of Gas Fields
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Economic and mathematical model of a group of gas fields is considered allowing forming the group development strategies for the long-term perspective. An algorithm for calculating the dynamics of gas production by fields and methods for calculating numerous technical and economic indicators of gas production and transport are presented. In addition, information is provided about the software implementation and use of the developed mathematical apparatus.

articleTitle: Lada Car Sales Models on the Russian Market
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Based on the hypothesis that the domestic demand in Russia for budget-class passenger cars, namely, the products of AvtoVAZ JSC, can be determined through a few socio-economic indicators of the standard of living. Models of a nonlinear time series of sales for the studied years and linear multi-factor sales models were constructed, which confirmed the hypothesis with a high degree of reliability.

articleTitle: Time series analysis and financial asset forecasting methods
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses the principal features of time series. Time series analysis makes it possible to identify trends, cycles, and seasonal variances to aid in the forecasting of a future event. Statistical forecasting methods and machine learning-based methods are described. Neural network models are widely used in stock market forecasting because of their inherent ability to identify complex nonlinear relationships present in given time series and to accurately approximate any nonlinear function.

articleTitle: Development of an Optimization Model for the Operating Modes of Heating Units under Conditions of Changing Energy Consumption Schedules
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The features of the mathematical model for optimizing the distribution of heat and electricity at a large CHP with a complex composition are considered. It is shown that when developing optimization models, it becomes necessary to calculate the optimization problem for different planning horizons. The requirements for the accuracy of the optimization model vary depending on the planning depth. Operational planning requires maximum precision. When planning for the medium term, forecast indicators are used that have a higher error. Therefore, the requirements for the optimization model can be less stringent. A detailed description of the components of the optimization model allows for high accuracy. In addition to accuracy, an important factor is the computational complexity or the time to find the optimal solution. Particular attention is paid to taking into account the amount of subcooling in network heaters when distributing the heat load between them.

articleTitle: Financing Mechanisms with Stochastic Cost Information
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of determining the amount of funding for the work that makes up the production task. Performers receive funds for the performance of work from a limited fund. The amounts of financing are defined with the planned costs for the performance of works. When determining the planned costs, the executors do not know the actual costs. To estimate the probable values of actual costs, performers use the actual cost distribution function.

articleTitle: Analysis of the efficiency of automation control at the national level
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A formalized description of industrial production is proposed covering various types of technological operations, various types of automatic machines, and various types of manufactured products. An important component of the formalized description is the probability of high-quality manufacturing of each technological operation by each machine and person. The task is to collect information about all types of technological operations, about all automatic machines and products in the country and make a unified database. The availability of such reference information will help make a quick decision on the feasibility of automating certain types of technological operations and produce products that are characterized by a minimum average cost.

articleTitle: Spot Prices Modeling Changes on the Wholesale Electricity Market in Russia with the Introduction of Carbon Payments as an Economic Incentive for the Power Industry Decarbonization
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article looks at the scale of changes in the electricity spot price at the wholesale market due to the application of carbon payments as an economic incentive for the power generation low-carbon restructuring. The carbon payments impact on the production costs and inter-fuel competition is also evaluated. Dispatching model was used as a spot market simulator to evaluate hourly and seasonal supply curve profile deviations and spot prices.

articleTitle: Data Replication in Ad-Hoc Mobile Networks MANET
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
