abstract: The paper proposes a method and a new heuristic algorithm for distributing data replicas in ad-hoc mobile networks MANET. The algorithm is based on the analysis of changes in the network topology and the traffic of requests to replica data. A method for redistribution of data replicas is proposed, which takes into account the special aspects of MANET networks and changes in the network topology. The algorithm uses several heuristics to efficiently redistribute replicas to maintain a high degree of availability and data integrity.

Author Keywords: redistribution of data arrays and their replicas

articleTitle: Transformation of Big Terminological Text into a Binary Homogeneous Oriented Network of Terms
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers the problem of integrity representation of the terminological text. As a first step towards the solution of this problem, a method for integrating definitions of notions into a binary homogeneous oriented network of terms is proposed. The implementation of the method is based on the use of the notion definition model as a system of terms. An example of method implementation is given. The conclusion is made about the need to automate the construction of a binary homogeneous oriented network for big terminological texts.

Author Keywords: binary homogeneous oriented network of terms
the hierarchical ordering of the system

articleTitle: Concerning Analysis and Control of Deviations of Economic Indicators of Countries Depending on Development of Hydrogen Power Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We develop mathematical models and methods to determine the appropriate path for developing hydrogen energy. The urgency of choosing this path proceeds from the fact that the development of hydrogen energy has a complex and not always a positive impact on other industries, the environment, and the leading economic indicators of the countries in the world. In this article, we propose to use system dynamics models to describe such relationships. The equations of system dynamics play the role of a control model in the considered problem of the variations calculus. This task determines control actions that minimize the weighted total deviation of the leading economic indicators from the required or indicative values. In determining these values, governments take into account the financial situation and the experience of previous periods. In addition, the problem under consideration includes restrictions on the resources and goals of the system and boundary conditions. Therefore, solving a problem means choosing a finite set of solutions and corresponding controls that satisfy the given requirements. Then we select control actions that minimize the objective function. These impacts correspond to scenarios and action plans to reduce the deviation of the leading economic indicators from the desired values under the influence of the hydrogen energy development in the country.

articleTitle: On The Existence of Minima of Differentiable Functions in Normed Spaces
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the problem of minimizing of a differentiable functional defined on a convex subset of a normed space. The classical conditions for the existence of minima in such problems contain explicitly or implicitly the assumption that the domain is compact in a certain topology. The corresponding proofs are based on the Weierstrass theorem. In this paper, we consider an approach based on a Carisiti-like condition and not containing the assumption that the domain of the functional is compact in any natural topologies. In terms of the first derivative of the functional, sufficient conditions for the existence of minima are obtained, and estimates of the distance from a given point to a certain minimum point are obtained. For locally Lipschitz functionals defined on finite-dimensional spaces, sufficient conditions for the existence of a minimum are obtained in terms of the Clarke's generalized derivative. An estimate for the distance from a given point to a minimum point is derived. Applications of the results obtained to abstract equations are discussed. As a corollary of sufficient minimum conditions, conditions for the solvability of abstract nonlinear equations and solutions estimates are obtained. In the final section, we obtain conditions for the existence of solutions to a system of inequalities defined by smooth functions.

articleTitle: AEROBOT-2020 UAV Challenge: A Report
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Scientific and engineering competitions on building autonomous mobile robots became an important part of research process. This is a report on Institute of Control Sciences' team participation in AEROBOT-2020 challenge with a description of proven approaches to solving competitive tasks.

articleTitle: Performance Measurement and Validation of the Distributed Digital Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper describes measurements and validation of a digital control system's performance (time) characteristic. Currently, in most cases, an industrial control (I&C) system is a distributed hybrid system combining hardware and software components that provide the necessary functionality. The I&C life cycle includes the stage of system tests to confirm its time characteristics concerning both speed (data processing time) in the system components and time (delay) of network data transfer between components. Various methods of time characteristic measurements are used. They depend on external conditions: experience and accepted practice and the properties of the measured parameters. In the work, we have researched the main statistical properties of the temporal characteristics of a typical I&C system for a Nuclear Power Plant (NPP). The measurements were carried out as with built-in system software as with an external testing agent. The results of both testings are discussed.

articleTitle: Visualizing Results of Promoting Campaigns
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Literature review related to the data exploration methods in marketing showed that the number of publications and software tools in the field of exploration data analysis of business processes has been increasing since 2015. The contribution of the given research lies in the hypothesis of the possibility to construct a quantitative model of a business process for big data containing fraud. At the first stage, we performed data cleaning and reduction, examined data distributions, and identified issues such as extreme values that supplement the previously developed visualization approach. The descriptive analysis helped us to describe the significant number of categorical features. We emphasized the data outliers that should be marked for further research.

articleTitle: Analysis of Decrease in Accuracy of Two-tier Trees without Using Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: It has been shown in previous papers that traditional approaches to feature selection can lead to learning a two-tier decision tree, which significantly loses in accuracy to a enumerate of all non-empty subsets of features containing no more than three features. In this paper, on a real, public dataset, we calculated how often such an accuracy loss can occur. It is shown that there is a statistically significant correlation between the coefficient of determination of a two-tier decision tree, constructed without any feature selection, and the magnitude of such a loss in accuracy. The characteristic values for the loss of accuracy in the construction of a two-tier tree without any feature selection, compared to a full enumeration of all nonempty subsets of features containing no more than three features, for a real dataset in some domain are calculated.

articleTitle: Deterministic Approach to Information Queries Parallel Batch Processing Modelling and Evaluating
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A deterministic analytical approach to modeling a batch processing of similar information queries in a multithreaded server on a single processor is considered. It is shown that the proposed approach allows getting an idea of the behavior and characteristics of the software server when processing queries in parallel mode. The features of the application of the model in a multi-core environment are described.

articleTitle: Calculation Algorithms for the Probability of Failure-Free Operation of a Large-Scale System with a Minimum Required Number of Heterogeneous Elements of the Loaded Reserve
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Calculation algorithms for the probability of failure-free operation of a large-scale system with a minimum required number of heterogeneous elements have been developed. The introduction of the analytical dependence within the proposed algorithm causes high accuracy and speed of the group operation regulation when performing flight tasks based on the comparison of alternative options of aircraft types.

articleTitle: Structure of Hyperloop Systems with Side Branches
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In the paper, we consider the structure of the extended passenger transport Hyperloop systems, when the mainline (magistral) has side branches. To preserve the system's speed capabilities, we divide the used passenger capsules into express capsules and local capsules. Express capsules use only the mainline, which they pass without stopping at the highest possible speed. Local capsules serve lateral branches and possible intermediate stations. These capsules travel between branches using the same mainline. At the same time, we offer solutions that ensure conditions when express and local capsules do not interfere with each other.

Author Keywords: the structure of Hyperloop transportation systems

articleTitle: Towards the Bicentric Architecture of Cybernetic Models of Sustainable Development of Large-Scale Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents an approach to studying the key laws (as regularities) of the development of the global computer environment based on a universal model of seamless-programmable and cybersecurity distributed computing in a mathematically homogeneous algorithmic space of arbitrarily large computer networks. The proposed approach made it possible to identify the fundamental factors of the joint informational influence of human and computer environments on the processes of digital transformation of large-scale sociotechnical systems. The basis of this approach is the general bicentric model and the corresponding computer-network architectures of its implementation, which open up opportunities for the agreed functioning and sustainable development of large-scale systems of new generations in the conditions of global information strongly-connectedness.

articleTitle: The Knowledge Description Language
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A knowledge base with a notional model of a subject domain is considered. The notional model consists of a notional structure and a content of notions included in it. The notional structure describes each notion as a result of the generalization or association of other notions. Enumerable and solvable sets of entities define the content of the notions. The notional structure contains the knowledge inference rules and is considered a formal theory of the subject domain that preserves the truth of all the consequences deduced in it. Declarative knowledge is represented by the notions with an enumeration of the entities belonging to them. Procedural knowledge is defined using the knowledge description language, which describes the notions with the solvable sets of the entities and facts and queries to the knowledge base. The fact is a true statement with the logical connectives, parentheses, and elementary expressions: unary predicates of belonging to an entity to the notion, functors for extracting the entities from the composite entities, and relations between the entities. A query is expressed as a fact with free occurrences of an entity variable. The execution of the query creates the notion with the entities for which the fact is satisfiable. The knowledge language provides operations for creating, deleting, and changing the entities and conditional and loop operators. The use of the knowledge description language allows you to increase the expressiveness of presentation and the efficiency of processing “large” knowledge.

Author Keywords: languages for describing and manipulating knowledge

articleTitle: Recovery Methods of Unmeasured Variables for Biological Models
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents modeling the SA-node operation. This research aims at comparing two different methods for constructing an observer according to some characteristics of numerical simulation for the pacemaker model: a nonlinear observer with linear error dynamics and a lower-order observer with nonlinear corrections. We compare two different observers using qualitative characteristics. The results show that the nonlinear observer with small tuning parameters converges more slowly than a lower-order observer. The nonlinear observer has the best accuracy with small tuning parameters. In the case of real-time monitoring, it is more optimal to use the nonlinear observer with linear error dynamics because it does not require a small integration step. The results can be appliyed to the further simulition of biological systems.

articleTitle: Data Exchange Module Implementation for NPP APCS Gateway between Upper Unit Level System and Lower Level Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This document describes structure and algorithms of the data exchange module of NPP APCS gateway, based on example of “gate” program for gateway interface software of upper unit level control system, developed in ICS of RAS. This “gate” program is designed to communicate with SICAM devices by Siemens AG, using IEC 60870-5-104 protocol.

articleTitle: The Coordinated Planning Methods in Hierarchical Organizations
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of complex activity coordinated planning, which is typical for hierarchical organizations. The authors have built a coordinated planning algorithm with integrated efficiency estimation for the case of separable costs. We also propose the method to account for the synergetic effects by analyzing the agent's activity occurrences in the vertex coverings of the complex activities' dependency graph.

articleTitle: Some Aspects of the Regional Structure of Investments
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Structural policy and the study of the structural aspects of investment processes are relevant for modern macroeconomics. Experts note the complexity of calculating quantitative characteristics and their qualitative interpretation, which affect the adoption of an investment decision. The paper considers some aspects of assessing regional structural indicators of the investment process.

articleTitle: Studying Collective Choice Influence on Laboratory Participants' Individual Actions
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to assess the degree to which the environment affects the choice of a participant in a laboratory experiment in simple static games and to study the effect of past repetitions of playing with other participants on their current actions. In order to obtain controlled conditions, interaction with other participants in laboratory experiments was replaced by interaction with robots that had predefined automated strategies.

articleTitle: Modeling the Expansion of the Production Capacity of Companies in the Oligopoly Market
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses the problem of choosing a strategy for expanding the production capacity of companies in a spatial oligopoly, which is formulated as a set of interrelated problems of nonlinear optimization with coupled variables. To solve it, a method is proposed for reducing the original problem to solving the mixed complementarity problem (MCP), as well as to solving mathematical programs with equilibrium constraints (MPEC). The prospects and directions of using the proposed approach to solving applied problems of the spatial development of production systems are discussed.

Author Keywords: development of production and transport systems

articleTitle: Supervised Learning in Large Transport Holding
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of production management of a large-scale holding with representative offices and enterprises in different regions under conditions of uncertainty is investigated. The mechanism of functioning of such a holding with a three-level management system, including hierarchical procedures of machine learning and stimulation, is considered. Sufficient conditions for the optimality of such a mechanism have been found, which ensure the use of stochastic possibilities for increasing the holding's production. The application of this mechanism is illustrated by the example of freight car repair management at Carriage Repair Company.

articleTitle: Forecasting Models for Passengers Evacuation's Characteristics from an Airplane in Emergencies on the Ground
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents the results of the research devoted to the development of a model for predicting the characteristics of the evacuation process of passengers and crew members from an airplane in emergency situations on the ground. The model is based on a system-dynamic approach. On the basis of a system analysis, the main characteristics of this process are chosen and the cause-and-effect relationships between them are identified. These characteristics and links are used to build a formalized model, which is presented as a system of differential equations. Using the developed model at various time intervals, computational experiments were carried out to determine the values of the characteristics of the process of evacuating passengers and crew members from an airplane in emergencies on the ground. The research results are supposed to be applied in information systems at some stages of the life cycle of aviation systems, for example, for making decisions in the design of advanced airplanes.

articleTitle: BIM Models Enhancement Through Simulation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The technique of combining BIM and simulation modeling is considered. The increasing role of BIM in building projects, along with the poor quality of the control aspect in BIM, is noticed. The enhancement of the BIM in the field of control modeling using different simulation models of logistics and evacuation is proposed.

articleTitle: Product Quality and Safety Management in Large-Scale Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A meat-processing enterprise as a complex system is considered. The algorithmic and software support for the numerical realization of the “Decision Tree” for each stage of the trophological chain for meat product manufacture from the field to fork, allowing to reveal hazards, identify risks, establish and characterize critical control points, is briefly described.

articleTitle: Coordination of the Functional Structure of the Decision Support and Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We have developed an approach to solving the problem of coordinating the functional structure of the decision support and management system based on the criterion of minimum losses from the harmful effects of industrial and vehicle air pollutants, based on the use of the mathematical apparatus of the theory of graphs and system dynamics.

articleTitle: Multi-Variant Simulation in the Preliminary Design of Technical Objects under Parametric Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper concerns the problem of multi-variant modeling when the information on non-deterministic parameters of the projectable technical object is formed based on expert data. The uncertainty theory has been chosen to represent such parameters. Using uncertainty theory, we developed empirical evidence processing algorithms.

articleTitle: Choosing the Degree of Localization of Production Taking into Account the Interests of the Project Participants
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the problem of choosing the degree of localization of production in Russia when implementing investment projects for the transfer of Western technologies. The problem is considered on the example of launching the production of innovative locomotives at Russian Railways. This type of investment projects refers to multipurpose projects. Each project participant has his own goal, the effectiveness of which should be assessed. A method is proposed for solving the problem according to the criterion of minimizing the “life cycle cost”, taking into account the coordination of the interests of the project participants.

articleTitle: Modeling Street Protests: Turnout Dynamics and Government Response
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new agent-based and network-based model of protest campaigns in the presence of repression from the authorities. It includes both rational and socio-psychological factors in the behavior of the protesters. An analytical study of the simplified form of the model (without a network structure) leads to two main findings. First, a protest campaign unfolds successfully, reaching a significant number of participants, only if it overcomes a certain turnout threshold before the start of repression. Second, there exists a critical level of repression's severity, at which the protest campaign will not survive, regardless of the initial number of participants. This threshold occurs when individuals have a relatively high level of risk aversion. A computational experiment has shown that its existence and value do not depend on the network topologies, traditionally explored in the literature - namely Watts-Strogatz, Barabási-Albert, and regular graph. Yet an experiment has also demonstrated that this “repression barrier” can be overcome by more specialized network structures. One of them is the special version of the so-called STAR topology, when the most active and the only agent is linked with all other agents, allows the protest campaign to survive at any rate of repression.

articleTitle: On control for reaching a consensus in multiagent systems with bounded opinion updates
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper describes and compares opinion control algorithms in a social network to reach a consensus. Agents trust only friends with close opinions. We found and formally showed that Overton window style control effectively increases consensus convergence for the bounded version of DeGroot and Friedkin-Jonhsen models. The controls have been evaluated on a real network. The network is a mixture of three real datasets of “advice”, “friendship”, and “report to” relations between managers of a high-tech company.

articleTitle: Estimation Method of Medical and Biological Signal Features in “Human-Computer” Interface Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: One of the most widely used methods for the analysis of biomedical signals is wavelet transformation. Covering a wide range of tasks, from compressing signals to finding correlations with mental functions, wavelet transformation algorithms have showed good results. Well-proven in electroencephalography (EEG) and electrocardiography (ECG) data processing, wavelet transformation nevertheless requires further enhancement focused on improving the detection of signal features relevant in an experiment or clinical study. This paper describes the method of creating filters that identify the features of biomedical signals based on the structure of chains of local extremums in the matrix of wavelet transformation coefficients. The paper also presents a method of selecting characteristic components related to operator activity from signals when working with Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems. There was also made a comparison with other methods of signal detection.

articleTitle: Selection of Equipment for Modernization of Enterprises with Conveyor Assembly of Products
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Consider the problems of modernization of enterprises, including several production units that produce component parts and conveyors for the assembly of manufactured products. Models and methods are suggesting for the choice of equipment for the modernization of enterprises.

articleTitle: Integration of optimization algorithms into the software of modern program and technical complexes
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problems arising during the integration of optimization algorithms of block and station levels into the application software of program and technical complexes (PTC) within the framework of the intelligent automated control system of thermal power plants are considered. The description of the results of the analysis of information and functional capabilities of modern PTC is given. The list of technical, information and software requirements for the automated control system of the thermal power plant and for the PTC for solving station-wide optimization tasks and their provision within the framework of the intelligent control system of the station as a whole is given. The possibility of using intelligent technologies, in particular, the machine learning method in the implementation of station-level optimization algorithms is described. Particular attention was paid to the methodology and practical approaches to the technical implementation of the calculation and control systems of the power plant's thermal power plant and optimal load distribution, as the most relevant and requested by the operating personnel. A brief description of the proposed technology of technical and information support of the automated control system of the station level within the framework of the intelligent automated control system of the station is given.

articleTitle: Hierarchical games with restrictions on the amount of information transmitted
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper examines a new class of models, the common feature of which is the presence of a limited volume of information exchanges between players. It is shown that taking such restrictions into account allows one to significantly expand the class of situations that can be adequately described using the games in normal form. Possible ways of formalizing the concept of “amount of information” are discussed, returning to the constructions by A.N. Kolmogorov. A new concept of the maximal guaranteed result is discussed. The application of the outlined ideas in the information theory of hierarchical systems is considered.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Railway Transportation for the Medium-Term Period with Forecasting of Production and Economic Indicators
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents the problem statements and the technology of predictive modeling of the railway transportation process within the medium-term period for the purposes of forming the budget indicators of JSC “Russian Railways” with the possibility of variant calculations. Examples of output and screen forms are given in the context of their subsequent use.

articleTitle: Convergent Ontologization of Collective Scientific Discoveries
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper addresses the acceleration of scientific discoveries by developing logical and cognitive ontologies in a special convergent way that ensures the acceleration and purposefulness of collective scientific discussions. It is noted that modern information systems, which have been created to support scientific activities, focus on information and reference work. They help analyse retrospective data to predict the development of events and reveal hidden relationships in big data and knowledge. At the same time, the known methods of creating ontologies are used to build artificial intelligence (AI) models by explicating the knowledge of experts and big data. It is shown in the paper that modern approaches to creating ontologies excessively reduce non-formalized and uncaused cognitive processes of scientific discoveries such as free will, consciousness, unconsciousness, feelings, thoughts, and experience. Attempts to formalize these processes lead to an incorrect and incomplete replacement of infinite-dimensional and continuous cognitive phenomena by finite-dimensional spaces, digital numbers, and discrete symbols. To compensate for the resulting cognitive distortions, a special approach has been developed to represent convergent scientific creativity processes in AI models more correctly and completely by using the capabilities of hybrid (human-machine) AI, the cognitive semantics of AI models, and the method of inverse problem-solving in topological spaces. The idea of using a nonlocal approach to enrich the cognitive semantics of AI models that considers the subatomic structure of the human mind's biological tissue is also considered. Currently, the proposed approach is successfully used for accelerating collective strategic planning in the real digital economy.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of CAMELS Framework and Macroeconomic Indicators on the Italian Cooperative Bank's Financial Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate which are the main factors that influence the performance of 10 Italian cooperative banks in the period between 2009 and 2020. In his genre, this scientific research is unique for the Italian framework and aims to fill the gap for the absence of research that uses the CAMELS system and the principal macroeconomic determinants to investigate the financial performance of the Italian cooperative banks. For this purpose, a balanced panel dataset has been used to perform panel data analysis and determine the preferable panel data model and assess which variables influence the cooperative's banks' financial performance. Our results suggest that some external factors influence cooperative banks, and, internally, the most impactful variable has been demonstrated to be the net interest margin (NIM). To enhance Italian cooperative banks' performance, the results suggest improving the general management practices, increasing efficiency, and creating trustworthy relationships with local customers.

articleTitle: Development and Research of Hybrid Intelligence Components Based on the Quadrant Enabled Delphi Method with the Associated Application of the Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper investigates the integration issues of new Hybrid Intelligence components implemented in the Data Envelopment Analysis technology based on the Quadrant Enabled Delphi method. Monitoring of activity and control of selective interaction of their multilateral communication with each other is provided by the Blackboard System based on Commonsense Knowledge to create a Virtual Semantic Environment. The report is illustrated by some examples of the consideration of these issues. In particular, attention is focused on the context of proactive protection of Hybrid Intellectual Property objects. The conditions for the emergence of a conditioned technological gap with the potential possession of such breakthrough technologies with reliable signs of Artificial Intelligence are also indicated.

articleTitle: Economic effect of managing the development of the domestic healthcare system on the basis of medical savings accounts
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article simulates the accumulation of financial resources on medical savings accounts (MSA) of working and non-working citizens of the Russian Federation for the period from 1994 to 2020 in the case of using in practice the system of compulsory medical insurance of citizens based on MSA instead of the existing system of financing domestic health care. Described and illustrated by calculations of all the elements of economic effect from the use of MSA: the accumulated funds of working citizens on MSA, the accumulated funds of non-workers on MSA, the economic effect through the out coming of working citizens of “shadow” and the economic effect by cost-cutting on seniors. The economic effect of using the MSA from 1994 to 2020, instead of the existing financing system, is estimated at 30.8 trillion rubles, while the main contribution (60.09% of the total amount) is accounted for by the out coming of working citizens from the “shadow”.

articleTitle: Modeling Bot Activity in the Online Political Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper presents a new agent-based model of political communication with the participation of bots - automated social media accounts. It aims to recreate politically significant informational interactions between Twitter users in a controlled environment. Our model incorporates a variety of options and mechanisms including limited attention, heterogeneity in account activity and performance characteristics, limited lifespan of tweets, and preferential attachment network structure. The features of political communication are reflected in the model through the ideological stances of human users and bots, varying tolerance levels, and leadership. We make a detailed description of the algorithms and test them using a computational experiment. The latter expectedly shows that the bots' reach increases in their proportion. More interestingly, it demonstrates substantial variation in the dynamics and levels of the reach of bots depending on the level of polarization and bot warfare.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Modeling of Traffic Flows through Signalized Intersection with Branching Routes
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A probabilistic model of traffic at a signalized intersection with branching routes is proposed, that is built in the form of a hybrid dynamic system and takes into account the scatter of static and dynamic parameters and driving of individual cars as well as the stochastic nature of the choice of the direction of passage of the intersection. The model can serve as a tool for forecasting and managing the traffic situation.

articleTitle: Generation of Petrophysical Parameters for Forecasting of Oil and Gas Deposits Development, Digital Core and Multi-scale
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Basing on main tertiary methods for increasing hydrocarbon deposit recovery, we define the set of microphysics processes to be simulated on digital core sample images to evaluate constitutive relations parameters for higher-scale computational models built on the continuum mechanics approach. We also investigated the problem of multi-scale model characteristics transfer from micro to macro levels.

articleTitle: Opportunities of Social Technology to Reduce the Negative Consequences of Informatisation
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problems of implementing IT systems in companies, risks and threats to information security in connection with the use of AI, positive and negative aspects of informatisation for society are considered. The special role of self-organising teams as a promising social technology for solving problems of common security is shown

articleTitle: Algorithms to Develop H2 Filling Station Nets
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Hydrogen transportation systems seem to be widely propagated very soon. However, its large-scale application is delayed due to «bulk» of traditional vehicles and their infrastructure enormously built since first Mercedes Benz (1886). Other alternative energy sources - electricity, solar, tidal- and wind-generation, recycling of wastes, etc. - may be also seen as competitors to hydrogen. That is why to manage the system development, one needs appropriate algorithms, with which the article deals with for hydrogen filling (service) station nets on macro-periods.

articleTitle: Fractal Neuromorphic Pattern Recognition Architecture for Experimental Physics
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A fractal neuromorphic architecture with repeated functional and structural properties of its elements at all levels of the internal hierarchy is proposed. The structure is focused on the search for rare useful events, “pyramid” processing of large volumes of experimental data in real time with minimal time delay.

articleTitle: Increasing the Intelligence of the Automated Process Control System by Managing the Current Energy Indicators of the TPP Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of increasing the intelligence and efficiency of the TPP automated control system on the basis of modern software and hardware complexes by controlling the current energy indicators (CEI) of each unit, unit and station as a whole is considered. The main causes of the discrepancy between the current and regulatory CEI are identified and recommendations are given for their prompt elimination. It is shown that the existing algorithms for calculating the CEI are limited to fixing the CEI values with a significant error due to the error of the initial information and the impossibility of combining the forward and reverse balances of individual units, the unit and the station with each other. To increase the reliability of the initial information, it is proposed to use an intelligent algorithm to obtain estimates of the values of technological parameters based on measurement results using a system of material and thermal balance equations. An indicator of the reliability of estimates in the proposed algorithm using neural technologies is the fulfillment of material and energy balances. The description of the algorithm for selecting a variable operational interval for calculating the CEI and the methodology for developing control actions to eliminate the difference between the current and normative CEI are given.

articleTitle: Development of the Basic Concepts of N.N. Moiseev and Yu.B. Hermeyer about Social Processes in Operational Game Scenario Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Qualitative (descriptive) and accurate representations of N. N. Moiseev and Yu. B. Hermeyer about social processes is considered. The development of these ideas in the works of their followers is analyzed. The principles of the accurate description of social processes in the framework of one of the directions of development of ideas of the Hermeyer-Moiseev school, of the operational game scenario modeling are described.
